extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded final mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF methods/results, figure captions/images, and DOCX supplement captions; no unsupported intracellular molecular target is added.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D-AP19 causes A. baumannii membrane permeabilization and depolarization in PI/BOX flow-cytometry assays at half-MIC and 1x MIC conditions.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=24:D-AP19 induced bacterial membrane depolarization and permeabilization leading to cell death

mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports membrane damage physiology; does not identify a single molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM and TEM show D-AP19-treated A. baumannii with roughened/distorted membranes, blebbing, intracellular leakage, and ghost-cell morphology.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=25:Ultrastructural evidence of D-AP19’s disruption and distortion of bacterial cell membranes

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports envelope disruption but is not a biochemical target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support alpha-helical conformation for AP19/D-AP19 in membrane-mimetic SDS and TFE environments, providing structure-function context for membrane activity.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=22:D-AP19 and its L-enantiomers formed an α-helical amphipathic conformation in membrane mimetic environments

mechanism_claims.limitations: CD conformation alone is context evidence and is not promoted to direct killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D-AP19 shows rapid A. baumannii killing in time-kill assays and low resistance induction during serial passage, recorded as phenotype support rather than molecular mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=23:D-AP19 exhibited rapid killing of A. baumannii

mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotype evidence supports rapid killing/low resistance tendency; no exact graph-only values are fabricated.

quality_controls.detail: Direct mechanism claims list flow cytometry or electron microscopy assay types.
Mechanism is bounded to membrane damage/structure-function evidence and rapid-kill phenotype.
